about: The Tutor's tools for agents (Agent Link's tool-data format).

tutor_point.description: Point at FreeCAD's controls for the person: numbered rings and a callout over the window; faces and edges lit in 3D. Never moves the cursor, opens a menu or switches workbench. targets (≤6): {cmd: "PartDesign_Pad"}, {menu: "PartDesign_Pad"}, {wb: "PartDesignWorkbench"}, {task: "Length" | {name, label, button}}, {tree: "Sketch"}, {face: {normal: [0,0,1], largest: true}, of}, {edge: {near: [x,y,z]}, of} (of beside the query), {sub: "Face6", of}, {dock: "Report view"}, {view: "3d"}. Replaces earlier highlights unless clear: false; no targets clears. A dropdown item: its ▾ arrow ringed. Another workbench's command: the selector ringed, "Switch to …" said first. dock finds a panel inside another dock's tab (Property view). Says why any target is not shown.

ms.description: Gone after this long; left out: until the next call.

tutor.description: Run a FreeCAD lesson in the person's window. list (query); start {lesson: id or inline {id: "inline.x", title, steps ≤30}, mode}; longer: batches, each with setup {after: id before}; next, back, hint, skip, do, stop, status {detail}, explain {on}, watch {on} (only when the person asks). demo: next does the step with the tools, then waits. guided: the person does it; checked as they and you act, on 0.6 s after a pass. hint: nudge, field, value; do: "Do it for me". mode switches any time. Write inline lessons in Simplified Technical English (imperative, one instruction per sentence, ≤20 words, UI names in bold, optional why): the validator refuses others with reasons. Checks include new {type, where: {Prop: v}}, sketch {dof}, expr {uses, count}, follows (part follows a parameter). start works in the open document when it is empty, else in a new one with a name not in use (document says which). demo makes the window ready for each step (workbench, Tasks or Model tab, tree unfolded: prepared) and passes a step already done. Answers {lesson, step: "n/m", say, because?, check, why, hint, targets}; at the end {step: done, finished, final: the last check}; a rider line (tutor: step n/m …) joins your other answers.

lesson.description: start: a lesson id (or its last part), or an inline lesson (≤30 steps; setup {after: id} to go on from a lesson before).

mode.description: start's mode (guided by default); with another action, switches.

query.description: list: words in the title, id or tags.

detail.description: status: the steps still to come too.

on.description: explain: the short why lines on or off (kept for the person).

tutor_watch.description: Follow what the person does in the window while watch mode is on (they turn it on; a badge shows). Waits up to wait s (0–25) for events after since; until: milestone ends the wait when they finish something (an object made, a panel closed with OK, a recompute, undo, save, a question). Events: {n, k: cmd|wb|sel|clr|new|del|rc|edit|done|undo|redo|save|ask, …}; give next as since in the next call. Answered off the window's thread. Off: says so.

since.description: The next of the last answer.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for an event.
